Class ActiveDirectoryRealmBase

java.lang.Object
org.apache.catalina.util.LifecycleBase
org.apache.catalina.util.LifecycleMBeanBase
org.apache.catalina.realm.RealmBase
net.sf.michaelo.tomcat.realm.ActiveDirectoryRealmBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
MBeanRegistration, Contained, JmxEnabled, Lifecycle, Realm
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActiveDirectoryRealm, Krb5AuthzDataDumpingActiveDirectoryRealm, PacDataActiveDirectoryRealm
public abstract class ActiveDirectoryRealmBase extends RealmBase
Base Active Directory realm which is able to retrieve principals for GSS names, fully established security contexts or TLS client certificates.
